t_about_1: I'm Gladys Ogo, known as The Keen-Eyed Proofreader — a law graduate and legal proofreader. Beyond legal proofreading, I lead conversations at the intersection of law, digital visibility and career development, working with legal brands, career organisations and communities while building a growing presence among law students and young legal professionals.
t_about_2: Through my content, speaking, consultations, brand collaborations and the Premium Law Students Community (PLSC), I turn these conversations into practical learning experiences around professional visibility in the evolving legal profession.
